description: This is a Python source file implementing an OpenAI content moderation guardrail for the LiteLLM framework. It defines the class `OpenAIModerationGuardrail` along with methods for initializing, making API requests to OpenAI's moderation endpoint, and integrating moderation checks at various stages of the LLM call process (pre-call, post-call, streaming).

classes.name: OpenAIModerationGuardrail
classes.description: A guardrail class that integrates OpenAI's content moderation API to scan prompts and responses, raising exceptions if harmful content is detected. It handles pre-call, moderation, post-call, and streaming moderation checks.

methods.name: __init__( self, guardrail_name: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, model: Optional[Literal["omni-moderation-latest", "text-moderation-latest"]] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Initializes the guardrail with configuration options, including API key, base URL, and model.

methods.name: Optional[str] _get_api_key(self)
methods.description: Retrieves the OpenAI API key from environment variables or secret manager.

methods.name: "OpenAIModerationResponse" async_make_request( self, input_text: str )
methods.description: Makes an asynchronous request to the OpenAI moderation API with input text, returning the response.

methods.name: None _check_moderation_result(self, moderation_response: "OpenAIModerationResponse")
methods.description: Checks the moderation response for flagged content and raises an exception if content is harmful.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] async_pre_call_hook( self, user_api_key_dict: "UserAPIKeyAuth", cache: Any, data: Dict[str, Any], call_type: Literal[ "completion", "text_completion", "embeddings", "image_generation", "moderation", "audio_transcription", "pass_through_endpoint", "rerank", "mcp_call", ], )
methods.description: Pre-call hook that scans user prompts before the main LLM call, raising exceptions if necessary.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] async_moderation_hook( self, data: Dict[str, Any], user_api_key_dict: "UserAPIKeyAuth", call_type: Literal[ "completion", "embeddings", "image_generation", "moderation", "audio_transcription", "responses", "mcp_call", ], )
methods.description: Moderation hook called during the call process to scan user prompts.

methods.name: "ModelResponse" async_post_call_hook( self, data: Dict[str, Any], user_api_key_dict: "UserAPIKeyAuth", response: "ModelResponse", )
methods.description: Post-call hook to scan LLM responses before returning to the user.

methods.name: AsyncGenerator["ModelResponseStream",None] async_post_call_streaming_iterator_hook( self, user_api_key_dict: "UserAPIKeyAuth", response: Any, request_data: Dict[str, Any], )
methods.description: Processes streaming responses for moderation, assembling chunks and checking content integrity.

methods.name: Optional[str] _extract_response_text(self, response: "ModelResponse")
methods.description: Extracts textual content from the model response for moderation checks.

methods.name: Optional[Type["GuardrailConfigModel"]] get_config_model()
methods.description: Returns the configuration model class for this guardrail.
